name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets for a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets for a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built entirely from scratch to fit your kitchen's exact dimensions and your specific design preferences, offering limitless options for materials, finishes, and configurations. Semi-custom cabinets are pre-manufactured in standard sizes but offer more flexibility than stock cabinets, with options for modifications in depth, width, and height, along with a wider selection of finishes and door styles. Custom typically offers superior fit and unique design, while semi-custom balances cost and design flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications, offering limitless design. Semi-custom cabinets are standard sizes with some customization options, balancing cost and flexibility.
